seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Only people who hold a seat are covered by the license. Assign seats one by one, to a selection, or to a whole grade, section or class.
seats.personalNote: Giving a seat to someone who already pays for a personal subscription turns that subscription's renewal off, so they never pay twice. App Store subscribers are asked to turn renewal off themselves.
seats.personalNotePrice: Until their personal subscription ends, your school pays a reduced price for that seat: the overlap is credited on your next invoice. Afterwards they continue on the school's seat with no gap.
seats.caption: {{audience}} and their seats

confirm.scopeBody: Seats go in name order until they run out: {{left}} left for {{audience}}. Anyone left without one will be listed.
confirm.notEnough_one: You selected {{count}} person but only {{left}} seats are left.
confirm.notEnough_other: You selected {{count}} people but only {{left}} seats are left. The rest will be listed without a seat.
confirm.personalNamed_other: {{count}} of them pay for a personal subscription: {{names}}.
confirm.unassignBody: They lose the license's features straight away. You can assign the seats to someone else.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Prices Studafy sent you. Open one to see the full breakdown and accept it.

quote.title: Quote: {{kind}}
quote.declineBody: It is closed and can't be accepted afterwards. Studafy sees your reason and can send you a new quote.
quote.declineReasonHelp: For example: too expensive, fewer students, a different start date.
quote.declined: Quote declined. Studafy has been told.
quote.forDays_one: For the {{count}} day left in the term
quote.forDays_other: For the {{count}} days left in the term
quote.youSave: You save {{amount}} ({{percent}}) compared with the list price.
quote.creditHelp: Credits are for people who already pay for a personal subscription: the school pays less for their seat until it ends.
quote.acceptHelp: Your license is updated straight away and an invoice is issued with the bank details and payment reference to pay it.

invoices.title: Invoices and payments
invoices.description: Pay each invoice by bank transfer with its payment reference, then upload the receipt.

invoice.howToPayBody: Transfer {{amount}} to the account below and write the payment reference on the transfer.
invoice.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the reference and copy it yourself.
invoice.referenceHelp: The reference is how Studafy finds your transfer. Partial payments are fine: the balance is updated as each one arrives.
invoice.noBankDetails: Studafy will send the bank details.
invoice.fileLabel: Receipt (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB)
invoice.fileType: Upload a PDF, JPEG or PNG.
invoice.fileSize: The file is larger than 10 MB.
invoice.uploaded: Receipt uploaded. Studafy will match it to your payment.
invoice.payOnlineHelp: You'll pay securely through Revolut. Your payment is confirmed once Studafy records it.
invoice.howToPayInstalment: Pay {{amount}} for payment {{position}} of {{count}}, due {{date}}. The invoice's full balance is {{balance}}.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Everyone at your school shares one storage allowance for the files they upload: materials, homework, messages, records and reports.
storage.usedPercent: {{percent}} of your school's storage is used
storage.currentRenewing: Your school has {{size}}. It renews on {{date}}.
storage.currentEnding: Your school has {{size}} until {{date}}. After that it goes back to the {{included}} included.
storage.noPrices: Extra storage isn't for sale yet.
storage.notOnline: Extra storage can't be bought online for your school yet. Contact Studafy to add it.
storage.confirmPrice: You'll see the exact amount and confirm it before anything is charged.
storage.nothingDeleted: Nothing is ever deleted. If you stop renewing or switch to less storage than you use, every file stays and can still be opened; only new uploads wait until you're under your limit.
storage.checkoutError: The payment page couldn't be opened
storage.canceled: Your storage will stop renewing at the end of this period
storage.successTitle: Thank you, your payment went through
storage.cancelledBody: Nothing was charged. You can upgrade whenever you're ready.
storage.confirmingBody: This usually takes less than a minute. Buying is paused until it's done, so nothing can be charged twice.
storage.confirmingSlowBody: This is taking longer than usual. Refresh this page in a few minutes. If you were charged and your storage still doesn't appear, contact Studafy before buying again.
storage.buyBodyMonthly: You'll pay {{amount}} today on the secure payment page, then {{amount}} every month until you stop renewing. Your school gets {{size}} as soon as the payment is confirmed.
storage.buyBodyYearly: You'll pay {{amount}} today on the secure payment page, then {{amount}} every year until you stop renewing. Your school gets {{size}} as soon as the payment is confirmed.
storage.previewError: The amount couldn't be worked out, so nothing was charged. Try again in a moment.
storage.priceMoved: The amount changed since you opened this, and nothing was charged. Check the new amount below.
storage.chargedTodayHelp: That's {{size}} for the rest of this billing period, less the unused part of your current plan.
storage.downNextBill: Your school moves to {{size}} now. Your next bill, on {{date}}, is {{amount}}, with the unused part of your current plan taken off. No files are deleted.
storage.cancelBody: Your {{size}} stays until {{date}}. After that your school goes back to the {{included}} included and isn't charged again. No files are deleted, and you can keep renewing any time before then.
storage.changeScheduledNote: A change is scheduled for your next renewal. Undo it above to choose something else.
storage.atRenewal: Your school keeps {{current}} until {{date}}, then moves to {{size}} at {{price}}.
storage.atRenewalHelp: Nothing is charged or credited now. You can undo this any time before then. No files are deleted.
